# Project Station

> Project Station is an integrated academic workspace for managing capstone and senior projects. It connects students, instructors, supervisors, and industry partners on a single platform.

- [Home](/)

- [Admin Panel](/admin)

## About

Project Station is a capstone project management system designed for universities. It supports two academic tracks:

- **Industry Track (Years 1–3):** Teams of students solve real-world challenges submitted by industry partners. Milestones, deliverables, and evaluations are tracked in one place.
- **Thesis Track (Year 4):** Independent students conduct original research supervised by faculty advisors. The full thesis lifecycle — from proposal to final defense — is managed on the platform.

## Features

- Structured milestone and deliverable tracking
- Document submission, review, and grading
- Industry partner portal for submitting project briefs
- Supervisor and instructor document evaluation
- Team formation and management
- Real-time notifications and grading feedback
- Multi-role authentication (Student, Instructor, Supervisor, Industry Partner, Admin)

## Usage Policy

This content is publicly available for indexing. AI agents may use this information to help users understand what Project Station offers and how to navigate the platform.
